title: HellForge
summary: Launches HellForge, the offline Helldivers 2, and manages its mods: start and end sessions, pick the profile, change its settings, read its logs, and put library mods into HellForge. HellForge itself is set up, repaired and synced in HellForge.exe.
intro: HellForge is an offline Helldivers 2 with a game copy of its own. This window starts it and manages its mods through HellForge's own command line.
synced: HellForge brought up to date with the library ({0} changes)
synced_1: HellForge brought up to date with the library (1 change)
not_found: No HellForge installation was found. It is a folder that holds hellforge-install.json; HellForge's installer suggests Documents\HellForge.
not_an_install: That folder holds no hellforge-install.json: it is not a HellForge installation.
not_ready: HellForge is not set up yet. Its first setup copies the game from Steam, confirms ownership and places the network block (one Windows administrator prompt). Only HellForge.exe can do this: open it once, then come back.
open_hellforge_setup: Open HellForge to set it up
stop_now_ask: End the game at once, without letting it close by itself? The game saves its shader cache only when it closes by itself.
stopping: Asking the game to close… (it is ended after 30 seconds if it does not)
play_no_bingus_ask: LUA mods are on, but Bingus Shared Loader is not. Without it, HellForge does not run them. Play anyway?
status_preparing: Preparing: building mods and checking the game copy
status_awaiting_network_block_install: Waiting for Windows to install the network block (answer the Windows prompt)
status_awaiting_windows_firewall_consent: Waiting for the firewall rules (answer the Windows prompt)
status_cleanup_failed: the cleanup failed: read the logs before playing again
lobbies_need_session: The lobby list comes from the session's own backend: start a session with co-op on, and every HellForge lobby is listed here.
lobbies_game_filter: The game's Quick Play and SOS only find lobbies on the same planet at the same difficulty; this list shows every lobby, on any planet and difficulty.
lobbies_starting: The session is starting; the lobby list follows once its backend is up.
lobbies_error: The list could not be read again: {0}
lobbies_unavailable: No lobby list in this session: {0}
quick_join_tip: An invitation to the best lobby to join now: a free slot, a friend's first, then the one that needs the least.
invited: An invitation from {0} is in the game: accept it there to join.
lobby_gone: That lobby is no longer in the list.
no_joinable: No lobby can be joined right now.
multiplayer_off: Co-op is off in this session: turn it on in Profile and settings, then start a new session.
verdict_trust: A mod waits for your trust (MOD SYNC)
verdict_unknown: Its mods are known only on joining
fix_edited_stats: Lobbies with host-enforced stat changes are hidden: HellForge's Mods page shows them when its setting is on.
needed: Mods that would let you into more lobbies
needed_hint: Lobbies you cannot join need these installed by hand; most needed first.
open_page_ask:
Open this address in the browser? It comes from another player's mod list:
{0}
locked: A session is running. HellForge keeps the mods it started with: they can be changed after it ends.
modlist_tip: Friends playing together need the same code: it is made from the shared gameplay mods.
modlist_none: None: no shared gameplay mod is on.
no_bingus: LUA mods are on, but Bingus Shared Loader is not: HellForge runs LUA mods through it only (never Boot Mod Loader or MDL3).
add_intro: The chosen mods are put into HellForge's mods folder: hard links to the library's files on the same drive, copies on another. The library's files are not changed.
add_none: Every library mod is already in HellForge.
add_there_already: Already in HellForge as "{0}", not from the library: remove that copy in HellForge first to use this one.
add_refused: Some mods were not put into HellForge:
refuse_not_a_mod: HellForge would not recognise it as a mod: it has no manifest.json with options, no patch files at its top level and no hellforge-mod.json.
refuse_same_id: HellForge already has this mod as "{0}", which was not put there from the library. Remove that copy in HellForge first, or keep it.
group_gameplay_hint: Friends need the same ones in co-op; they make up the modlist code.
group_per_player_hint: Each player keeps their own: not in the modlist code, never downloaded in co-op.
group_cosmetic_hint: Client-only: never part of the modlist code.
all_only_me: Every gameplay mod only affects me
all_only_me_hint: Each shared gameplay mod that is not one of HellForge's own is counted as this player's own, now and whenever one is added: the modlist code is HellForge's own mods only, so players with different mods can still join each other. Works best when everyone in the community turns it on.
all_only_me_ask:
Count every shared gameplay mod as only affecting you?

Players with different gameplay mods can then join each other, and each player's game runs with that player's own mods. A mod that changes the game for everyone (enemies, missions, the host's rules) then behaves differently on each player's machine in co-op.

HellForge's own mods stay shared. Mods HellForge does not allow to be per-player stay shared too, and are listed.
all_only_me_done: {0} gameplay mods now only affect you
all_only_me_done_1: 1 gameplay mod now only affects you
all_only_me_refused_tell: HellForge does not allow these mods to be per-player (their changes must be the same on every machine); they stay shared:
only_me_tip: Counted as this player's own in co-op ("coop": "per-player"): left out of the modlist code, never downloaded by friends.
only_me_ask:
Mark "{0}" as only affecting you?

Do this only for mods that each player could use on their own in the official game. A mod that changes gameplay for everyone, marked this way, makes the players' games disagree in co-op.

The change is written into HellForge's copy of the mod, and made again when a new version comes without it.
move_up: Move up (loads later, wins over the one above)
remove_ask: Take "{0}" out of HellForge? Its files in the library stay as they are.
profile_hint: Each profile has its own progress and inventory.
profile_name_rule: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
war_hint: Frozen: the war HellForge ships. Live: the current war, read-only. Open: every planet open.
strangers_hint: List public lobbies and let strangers join. Their games send data that nobody checks.
strangers_ask:
Play with strangers?

HellForge is open source and has no anti-cheat: a stranger's game sends data that nobody checks. HellForge recommends the sandbox for this.
sandbox_hint: The game runs at low integrity, with Steam through HellForge's Steam broker.
forge_credits_hint: The share of random loot caches that hold Forge Credits (HellForge's default: 30 %). Everyone in a co-op mission should use the same value.
account_hint: Syncing the inventory from the live game is done in HellForge.exe: HellForge has no command for it yet.
account_sync_how: HellForge opens now. Sync the account there (Sync Inventory).
proxy_on: The Windows system proxy is on: HellForge's account sync fails while it is. Switch the system proxy off in the proxy tool (Clash and the like) before syncing.
proxy_ask: The Windows system proxy is on, and HellForge's account sync fails while it is. Switch it off in the proxy tool (Clash and the like) first.
languages_hint: English is always in HellForge's game copy.
language_steam: Download it in Steam first: paste this into Steam's console (steam://open/console).
logs_hint: The newest ten sessions are kept, and of older ones the five newest that crashed.
ended_error_hint: The game left a crash dump or an error code when it closed. On HellForge's game version this also happens when the game is quit normally; a crash report shows more.
dump_ask: Add the full crash dump? It is the game's memory and cannot be cleaned of personal data; send it only to people you trust.
crash_report_done: The crash report is saved as {0}. Nothing was uploaded. To report the crash, attach it to a new issue at {1}.
note_in_tip: This mod is in HellForge's mods folder.
note_stale_tip: The library's files changed since the mod was put into HellForge; the HellForge window brings them over.
risk_render_config: Replaces the render configuration built for the official game: on HellForge's game version the whole picture can turn false-colour. It needs a HellForge build of the mod.
risk_strings: Replaces game text tables built for the official game: on HellForge's game version text can be wrong or missing.
risk_bml: Its LUA calls Boot Mod Loader's own API: HellForge runs Bingus Shared Loader, not Boot Mod Loader.
